content_zh:
(新书的更新我都会尽量稳定，晚上12点一章，早上8点一章，下午四点一章。)

轩辕毕竟是第一次自己见到这种凶悍的魔兽，一时之间也被惊得手脚发颤，上辈子轩辕里哪见过这么大的一头魔熊？心里狂呼了一声：

“好不容易有了次重生的机会，难道我要死在这里了？如果连眼前一只魔熊都可以杀了我，我还配叫什么轩辕，拼了！”

生死刹那之间，轩辕体内的血性被彻底的激发了出来，抓起腰间那一把沾染着铁锈的黑色匕首，忍着疼痛站起身来，爆发出自己的极限，猛然一跳，朝着魔熊的脖子抹去，这一把匕首长有四十厘米，更像是一把小剑，就在轩辕握住这把黑色匕首的瞬间，突然有了一种很怪异的感觉，自心头油然而生，但是又说不清楚什么，反正现在也管不了那么多了，轩辕没有多想。

这魔熊似乎有了灵智，看到这一把破破烂烂的匕首，眸子里闪过一丝嘲笑，朝着匕首咬去。

然而就在魔熊那尖锐的獠牙咬住匕首的瞬间，獠牙寸寸崩碎，鲜血直流。

在鲜血染上匕首的那一刻，突然这匕首仿佛活物一般，骤然炸开，化为无数条黑色的细线，直接死死地扎入了魔熊的头部，死死地缠绕着，不仅如此，就连轩辕那抓住匕首的手，仿佛也被死死地黏在一起。

轩辕的身体猛然一震，无数的黑色丝线，凝聚出一道黑芒贯入了他的体内，轩辕只觉得自己身上的伤，逐渐好转，力量也逐渐在膨胀，在轩辕那惊恐的目光中，魔熊挣扎了片刻之中，身体以肉眼可见的速度迅速干瘪了下去，最后只剩下了一张皮毛。

如今的自己，身上的伤口迅速结痂愈合，而且饥饿感全消，感觉到全身上下力量充盈，再看看手中的匕首，几点斑驳的铁锈脱落，闪过几道稍纵即逝的黑色幽光后，变得跟原来没有两样。

刚才在生死一线间，激发出轩辕骨子的那一股凶狠，但是在结束之后，轩辕却是被惊出了一身冷汗，浑身湿漉漉的，大口大口地喘着粗气，这一切都太让自己感觉到匪夷所思了，即使在这身体以前的记忆，也从来没有出现过这样的情况！

顿了一会，轩辕这才回过神来，连忙用匕首将魔熊的皮毛给割开，要知道这可是能够卖不少钱的。

由于得到了这一身的记忆，所以对于怎么割开皮毛才能够卖得最高价，轩辕也割的极为顺手，而且魔熊被那一道古怪的力量给吸得干干净净，血肉都没有了，割起来也极为顺手，做完这一切轩辕将厚厚的魔熊皮毛叠起，看着全身骨架完好的魔熊，眼前一亮：

“魔熊的骨骼，也能够卖不少的价钱！”

伸手一抓，原本那完好无损的骨架，瞬间炸开，化为飞灰，随风飘散，轩辕愣了一下，不禁觉得有些遗憾，叹了一声，忽然见看到一颗有鹅卵石大小的血红色内丹静静地躺在地上。

轩辕自然知道这内丹的珍贵之处，心中大喜，这样一来，只要把内丹卖了，就能买到好的丹药，好的装备，最大限度保证自己的安全。

“在上一辈子，这些都是无稽之谈，没想到这个世界竟然如此神奇，看来，我以前想要成仙，腾云驾雾，不是梦了！”

轩辕顿时豪气万丈，斗志昂扬，就在这时候，孤星嘴里咬着一只小野猪，也算是收获颇丰了。

“孤月呢？”轩辕看到孤星，一下子便想到了孤月，就算孤月死了，也要将其好好安葬。

孤星仿佛听懂了轩辕的话，狼瞳里闪过一丝悲恸，摇了摇头。

轩辕知道，永远再也找不到孤月了，心中一痛：

轩辕通过记忆中，知道，他的家就在离这里不远处的一座参天大树里。

一人一狼，不缓不急，朝着他们的家里走去，一边走着，轩辕一边读取他的记忆，这一座参天大树里面，是被他用这一把看似锈迹斑斑，极钝的匕首，一刀一刀挖出来的，里面有一张简单的床，一张魔虎皮铺成的床单，其他的树墙上都挂满了他的战利品，一张张完整的魔狼皮，铺在地上，想象中，是一个温暖的小家，在这树房的中心有一道直径米许的深坑，是日常用来烹煮食物的地方，在这种野外，炊烟很容易引其别人的注意，只要让人发现，下场有可能就是死无葬身之地，可想而知，在这个世界有多么的凶险。

轩辕从他的记忆中看到，像他这样独立生存的人，要么就进去月荒城中家族之中，当家族中的奴才打手之流，要么就是成为佣兵，让人雇佣护镖，或者做些见不得人的勾当，运气好的，资质不错的，就会被一些门派给收为弟子，从此衣食无忧，只需要修炼或者完成门派的任务，运气不好的，就是被人抢光所有的东西给杀了，女的还有可能会被先、奸后杀。

此时此刻，轩辕才感受到原来自己依然是那么的无助，想要在这一片陌生而且残忍的世界，闯出自己的一片天地，是如何的艰难，自己想要向月荒城中的城主之子，月绝复仇，有那个希望吗？

感觉到自己有些气馁，轩辕知道，人最怕的就是少了精神，少了勇气，少了原则，少了自己的意志，没了这些，一个人只能说是活得行尸走肉，所以轩辕下定了决心。

“不管用尽什么要的方法，我绝对会为你报仇的，既然我附生到你的身体上，这算是我唯一能对你的回报了，你和孤月的灵魂，看着我，我一定会完成自己的誓言。”

又一次，轩辕给自己心里鼓劲时，已经走到自己家门口了，从一个很隐秘的地方，拉开树门，一切与自己想象中没有太大的差别。

然而就在轩辕带着孤星走进树房，看向自己那一张树床时，一下子呆住了。

轩辕揉了揉眼睛，一下子愣在原地，只见一名女子，身着露肩的雪白连衣丝裙，一袭长发随意披散在身后，仿佛最顶级的黑色的丝绸，顺到腰间，玉体横陈，香肩圆润，精致完美的锁骨下，酥胸露出了一小片，水灵灵，白嫩嫩的肌肤，看得轩辕直吞口水，一双眼睛瞪大了，直直地看着。

“不看白不看，活了一辈子，也没见过这么漂亮的女子，多看一眼都是赚啊，一千个赵寡妇也没她一个手指头好看啊……”

被本性不坏，却有些好色的老乞丐，经常带去偷看赵寡妇洗澡的轩辕，此刻浑身上下，热血沸腾啊。

那一张完美的瓜子脸上的神态给人几分安详，隐隐之间透露着一丝悲伤，在她那长长的睫毛挂着一滴细微的水珠，平静的神情，香腮红一抹，没来由给人一种心中宁静的感觉，不可方物。

也许是因为隔三差五就会去偷看赵寡妇洗澡的轩辕，顺着脸蛋看到胸部，看到那一双随意摆放的玉手，看到那纤细的腰肢，看到那雪白的连衣裙，覆盖到膝盖部位，露出那一双莹润的玉足，从那连衣裙的轮廓，就可以想象出眼前这女子那一双修长笔直的玉腿。

砰砰，砰砰，轩辕感受到自己那剧烈的心跳，虽然不知道眼前这女子是什么人，但是这可是自己的家，她竟然还睡在自己的床上，简直有点不像话，不像话就不像话吧，轩辕壮起胆子，带着点紧张，一步一步走在地上那铺着魔狼皮的地毯。

“屁股呢，还没看到屁股呢，老乞丐可说了，屁股要跟十五一样的月亮才好看……”

什么热血的誓言，都在一瞬间被轩辕抛到九霄云外了。

轩辕憋着一口气，一步一步走上前去，女子身上的露肩的连衣丝裙，由于侧躺着将胸前那一对饱满挤出了一条沟渠，那紧贴在身上的连衣丝裙，更是将完美的臀形给勾勒出来，靠近了这女子，轩辕在闻到自女子身上所散发出来一股自然的体香，沁人心脾，让人心旷神怡。

“完美啊……这才是完美啊……感谢上苍啊，你果然是公平的，竟然平白无故送了这么一个大美女给我。”

轩辕心头激动着，伸出了自己的手，推了推女子的臂膀，在触碰到女子的玉臂之时，轩辕再度泪流满面了，感谢上苍。

“再好的触感也不过如此了吧，这才完美啊，滑溜溜的啊……”

忍住了自己那激动而沸腾的灵魂，轩辕咳了咳，有点不自然地轻声道：

在这如同蚊虫叫般的呼唤声中，轩辕原本就没打算真的把女子叫醒，可是却没想到这女子竟然真的醒了，一对美眸突然睁开，给人一种说不出的空灵，仿佛精灵一样，充满无尽的妩媚与诱惑，但是女子的神色却是寒冷的，轩辕只感觉到眼前一晃，连女子的动作都没有看清楚，只觉得额头一痛，整个人飞了出去，飘飘欲仙，直接滚了两三下，轩辕一个驴打滚，站了起来，一手捂着额头，一手指着眼前的冰霜美人，怒吼道：

冰霜美人看了看眼前的愣小子，很甜地笑了，一笑倾城倾国，也不过如此了。

原本极度愤怒的轩辕一下子傻了，愤怒全消，眼前的女子抛开她仙子般的容貌不讲，轩辕当了小乞丐那么多年，人情冷暖，好人坏人，凭心，感觉得出来，至少眼前这女人，在轩辕看来，并不坏，算是一个好人。

After all, this was the first time for Xuanyuan to see such a ferocious monster, and he was so frightened that his hands and feet were trembling. How had Xuanyuan ever seen such a big monster bear in his previous life?I shouted in my heart:

"I finally have a chance to be reborn. Am I going to die here? If even a demon bear in front of me can kill me, why should I be called Xuanyuan? Give it a try!"

In the moment of life and death, the blood in Xuanyuan's body was completely aroused. He grabbed the rusty black dagger at his waist, stood up despite the pain, exploded to his limit, jumped suddenly, and wiped it towards the demon bear's neck. This dagger was long.It was 40 centimeters, more like a small sword. The moment Xuanyuan held the black dagger, he suddenly had a very strange feeling, but he couldn't explain what it was. Anyway, he couldn't care about that much now, so Xuanyuan didn't think much about it.

The demon bear seemed to have gained intelligence. When he saw the tattered dagger, a trace of ridicule flashed in his eyes and he bit towards the dagger.

However, the moment the demon bear's sharp fangs bit the dagger, the fangs shattered inch by inch and blood flowed out.

The moment the blood stained the dagger, it suddenly exploded like a living thing and turned into countless thin black threads, which directly plunged into the demon bear's head and entangled it tightly. Not only that, even Xuanyuan's hand holding the dagger seemed to be tightly glued together.

Xuanyuan's body suddenly shook, and countless black threads condensed into a black light that penetrated into his body. Xuanyuan only felt that the injuries on his body were gradually getting better, and his strength was gradually expanding. In Xuanyuan's frightened eyes, the demon bear struggled for a moment, and its body quickly shriveled up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and finally only a piece of fur remained.

Today, the wounds on my body have scabbed and healed quickly, and my hunger has completely disappeared. I feel that my whole body is full of strength. Looking at the dagger in my hand, a few mottled rusts have fallen off. After a few fleeting black lights, it has become the same as before.

Just now, in the thin line between life and death, the ferocity in Xuanyuan's bones was aroused, but after it was over, Xuanyuan was shocked into a cold sweat, his whole body was wet, and he was breathing heavily. All of this made him feel incredible. Even in this body's previous memory, such a situation had never happened!

After a pause, Xuanyuan came to his senses and quickly cut open the demon bear's fur with a dagger, as you should know that this could be sold for a lot of money.

Because he had obtained the memory of this body, Xuanyuan also cut it very smoothly on how to cut the fur in order to sell it at the highest price. Moreover, the demon bear was sucked clean by that weird power, and all flesh and blood was gone. It was also very easy to cut. After doing all this, Xuanyuan folded up the thick fur of the demon bear. Looking at the demon bear with intact skeleton, his eyes lit up:

"The bones of a demon bear can also be sold for a lot of money!"

He stretched out his hand to grab it, and the originally intact skeleton exploded in an instant, turning into fly ash and scattering in the wind. Xuanyuan was stunned for a moment, and couldn't help but feel a little regretful. He sighed, and suddenly saw a blood-red inner elixir the size of a pebble lying quietly on the ground.

Xuanyuan naturally knew the preciousness of this inner elixir, and was very happy. In this way, as long as he sold the inner elixir, he could buy good elixirs and good equipment to ensure his own safety to the maximum extent.

"In my previous life, these were all nonsense. I didn't expect that this world would be so magical. It seems that my dream of becoming an immortal and flying in the clouds is no longer a dream!"

Xuanyuan suddenly felt heroic and high-spirited. At this moment, Lone Star had a small wild boar in his mouth, which was considered a fruitful harvest.

"Where is Gu Yue?" When Xuanyuan saw Gu Xing, he immediately thought of Gu Yue. Even if Gu Yue died, he must be buried properly.

Lone Star seemed to understand Xuanyuan's words, a trace of sadness flashed in his wolf eyes, and he shook his head.

Xuanyuan knew that Gu Yue would never be found again, and his heart ached:

Xuanyuan knew from his memory that his home was in a towering tree not far from here.

One man and one wolf, walking slowly and unhurriedly towards their home. As he walked, Xuanyuan read his memory. Inside this towering tree, he dug out one by one with a seemingly rusty and extremely blunt dagger. There was a simple bed inside, a sheet made of magic tiger skin, and other tree walls were covered with his trophies.A complete piece of devil wolf skin is spread on the ground. In the imagination, it is a warm little home. In the center of the tree house is a deep pit with a diameter of about 1 meter, which is used for daily cooking. In this kind of wilderness, the smoke can easily attract the attention of others. As long as people find it, they may end up dead without burial. It can be imagined how dangerous this world is.

Xuanyuan saw from his memory that people like him who lived independently would either join the family in Yuehuang City and work as a slave thug in the family, or become a mercenary and have people hire bodyguards, or do some shady things, luck.Those who are good and have good qualifications will be accepted as disciples by some sects. From then on, they will have no worries about food and clothing. They only need to practice or complete the tasks of the sect. Those who are unlucky will be robbed of everything and killed. Women may be raped first and then killed.

At this moment, Xuanyuan felt that he was still so helpless and how difficult it was to break out of his own world in this strange and cruel world. He wanted to take revenge on Yue Jue, the son of the city lord in Yuehuang City. Is there any hope?

Feeling a little discouraged, Xuanyuan knew that what people fear most is lack of spirit, lack of courage, lack of principles, and lack of own will. Without these, a person can only live like a zombie, so Xuanyuan made up his mind.

"No matter what method I use, I will definitely avenge you. Since I am attached to your body, this is the only reward I can give you. Your soul and Gu Yue's soul, look at me, and I will definitely fulfill my oath."

Once again, when Xuanyuan was encouraging himself, he had already reached the door of his house. He opened the tree door from a very private place. Everything was not much different from what he imagined.

However, when Xuanyuan led Lone Star into the tree house and looked at his tree bed, he was stunned.

Xuanyuan rubbed his eyes and froze for a moment. He saw a woman, wearing a strapless snow-white silk dress, with long hair hanging casually behind her, like the finest black silk, down to her waist. She had a jade body, round shoulders, delicate and perfect collarbones, and a small piece of breasts exposed. Her watery, white and tender skin made Xuanyuan swallow his saliva. His eyes widened and he looked straight at it.

"It's all in vain. I've never seen such a beautiful woman in my whole life. It's a profit to take another look. A thousand Widow Zhao is not as beautiful as one of her fingers..."

Xuanyuan, who was often taken to peek at Widow Zhao's bathing by an old beggar who was not bad in nature but somewhat lustful, felt his blood boiling all over his body at this moment.

The expression on that perfect melon-seed face gives people a sense of tranquility, with a hint of sadness hidden in it. There is a tiny drop of water hanging on her long eyelashes. The calm expression and a touch of fragrant blush give people a sense of peace in the heart for no reason, which is indescribable.

Maybe it's because every once in a while, I would peek at Xuanyuan where Widow Zhao was taking a bath. I followed her face to see her breasts, her casually placed jade hands, her slender waist, and her snow-white dress, which covered her knees, revealing her pair of lustrous jade feet. From the outline of the dress, you could imagine the slender, straight jade legs of the woman in front of you.

Bang bang, bang bang, Xuanyuan felt his violent heartbeat. Although he didn't know who the woman in front of him was, this was his own home. She was still sleeping on his bed. It was a bit outrageous. If it was outrageous, it would be outrageous. Xuanyuan plucked up the courage, and with a little nervousness, walked step by step on the carpet covered with magic wolf skin.

"Where's the butt? I haven't seen the butt yet. The old beggar said that the butt needs to be the same as the fifteenth moon to look good..."

Any passionate vows were thrown out of the window by Xuanyuan in an instant.

Xuanyuan held his breath and stepped forward step by step. The woman's strapless silk dress squeezed out a ditch on her chest because she was lying on her side. The silk dress that clung to her body even more outlines her perfect hip shape. As he got closer to the woman, Xuanyuan smelled a natural body fragrance emanating from the woman's body, which was refreshing and refreshing.

"Perfect... This is perfect... Thank God, you are indeed fair and gave me such a beautiful woman for no reason."

Xuanyuan was so excited that he stretched out his hand and pushed the woman's arm. When he touched the woman's jade arm, Xuanyuan burst into tears again, thanking God.

"No matter how good the touch is, it can't be more than this. This is perfect, so slippery..."

Holding back his excited and boiling soul, Xuanyuan coughed and whispered unnaturally:

In this cry like a mosquito, Xuanyuan had no intention of actually waking up the woman, but he didn't expect that the woman actually woke up. A pair of beautiful eyes suddenly opened, giving people an indescribable ethereal look, like an elf, full of endless charm and temptation, but the woman's expression wasIt was so cold that Xuanyuan only felt a flash in front of his eyes. He didn't even see the woman's movements clearly. He only felt a pain in his forehead. He flew out and rolled two or three times. Xuanyuan rolled like a donkey and stood up. He covered his forehead with one hand and pointed at the frost beauty in front of him and roared:

The Frost Beauty looked at the stunned boy in front of her and smiled sweetly. Her smile could captivate an entire country, but that was all.

Xuanyuan, who was originally extremely angry, suddenly became stupid. All his anger disappeared. The woman in front of him put aside her fairy-like appearance. Xuanyuan had been a beggar for so many years, and he could feel the warmth and warmth of people, good people and bad people. At least in Xuanyuan's opinion, the woman in front of him was not bad and could be considered a good person.
